description_en: Invoke this API to query the status of a batch LoRaWAN device registration job
description_zh: 调用该接口查询批量注册LoRaWAN设备任务的状态
name: GetLoraNodesTask

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.

You can obtain the **ID** of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If your instance has an ID, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the request fails.

> The ID of a public instance may not be displayed on the Overview page. For more information about how to obtain the instance ID, see [How do I obtain an instance ID?](~~267533~~)
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。

parameters.description_en: The ID of the task for creating the LoRaWAN devices. You can call the [CreateLoRaNodesTask](~~109299~~) operation and obtain the task ID from the value of the **TaskId** response parameter.
parameters.description_zh: 注册LoRaWAN设备任务的ID，即调用[CreateLoRaNodesTask](~~109299~~)创建任务后，返回的**TaskId**。
